title: Netaji Subhas-ICAR International Fellowship (NS-ICAR IF)
official_source: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
program_type: International doctoral research fellowship in agriculture and allied sciences
description: The Netaji Subhas - ICAR International Fellowship (NS-ICAR IF) funds a three-year Ph.D. in agriculture and allied sciences in identified priority areas, for both Indian candidates studying abroad and overseas candidates studying at Indian Agricultural Universities in the ICAR-AU system. Thirty fellowships are available each year. The award pays a monthly stipend plus a contingent and preparatory lump sum and provides a to-and-fro economy class air ticket, but host institution fees, medical insurance and medical fitness are all paid by the fellow.

title: IIT Kanpur Institute Fellowship (for International Students)
program_type: Institute-funded monthly fellowship for admitted international degree students
duration: Tied to the degree programme, for MTech, MS (Research), MDes, MBA or PhD as admitted
description: Doctoral-fellowship in India for ASEAN (DIA) (Government of India)

title: Fellowship for International Research Scholars in Technology at IIT Hyderabad (FIRST@IITH)
program_type: Fully funded doctoral fellowship for international research scholars
description: FIRST@IITH supports outstanding international scholars - foreign nationals excluding OCI and NRI holders with a master's degree in engineering or technology and a minimum CGPA of 8.5 on a 10-point scale - to pursue a four-year PhD at IIT Hyderabad with full financial support, paying a fellowship of INR 60,000 per month and contingency support of INR 1,00,000 per year with no application fee.

title: KIIT University India Scholarships Programme (KUISP)
official_source: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) Deemed to be University
program_type: Tuition fee scholarship for international students across UG, PG and doctoral programmes
duration: For the whole duration of the chosen course, typically three, four or five years for undergraduate programmes, two years for postgraduate programmes and the full doctorate duration
description: KIIT Deemed University announces the KIIT University India Scholarship Program (KUISP), applicable to foreign national applicants to pursue professional education in India at KIIT-DU, for regular undergraduate, postgraduate and doctorate programmes and for short-term training programmes.

title: Alan and Jane Handler Endowed Scholarship
duration: Four years, covering tuition and mandatory fees for up to eight semesters or until the first bachelor's degree requirements are met, whichever comes first
description: With a permanently endowed fund, the Alan and Jane Handler Scholarship is awarded to selected students who do not otherwise have the financial means to attain a URochester education.

title: Berea College Tuition Promise Scholarship
program_type: Need-aware tuition promise awarded to all admitted students, not a competitive merit scholarship
duration: Four years, renewed annually while the student remains enrolled and files the FAFSA each year
description: Berea College plans to move to a fully funded program model for all students by fall 2027, expanding its tuition-free approach to cover housing and meal plans with no student loans.

title: Duke University Karsh International Scholars Program
program_type: Merit and need-based university scholarship for international undergraduates, awarded by Duke University's Office of University Scholars and Fellows
duration: Four years. Duke University issues four-year aid awards for international applicants; once the aid award is complete, it is automatically renewed for the applicant's subsequent years at Duke. The award also includes three summers of funding.
description: The Karsh International Scholarship was founded at Duke University in 2010 through a donation from Martha L. and Bruce A. Karsh. It brings together a cohort of international undergraduates who promote interdisciplinary inquiry, academic research and scholarship in the service of society. International applicants must have demonstrated financial need to be eligible. The award covers tuition, room and board, mandatory fees, demonstrated need beyond those costs, and three summers of funding for research, unpaid internships and other career-advancing opportunities. There is no separate application
